flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4310/ then You are a blind user who navigates with the keyboard only (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, arrow keys).
The mouse does not work and the screen is black.
Book 2 seats in row F for Friday's show.
At checkout use the name Alex Rivera, the email alex@example.com and the test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 with expiry 12/30 and CVC 123.
Verify, by reading the page text as a screen reader would, that the page says "You're going! Order #ENC-4821 · Row F · Seats 14–15".

summary:
The booking controls for the Friday show and individual seats are not reachable when moving through the page with the Tab key. The keyboard reaches only the quantity controls.
Make the Friday show option and every available seat reachable by Tab, with a clear keyboard focus indicator. Retest the full booking flow using only Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, and arrow keys.
evidence: objective_contradiction: Tab skips Friday and all seats, leaving only quantity controls; keyboard-only booking cannot be completed.
one_liner: Keyboard-only users cannot choose Friday or select seats, so they cannot complete this booking.
